description: President Donald Trump issued an executive order in 2025 titled 'Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence' that repealed Biden-era AI rules.

instances.assertion: President Donald Trump issued an executive order in 2025 titled 'Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence' that repealed Biden-era AI rules.
Executive Order 14179 of January 23, 2025, directed the Administration to remove barriers to U.S. AI leadership.
President Trump signed an Executive Order on December 11, 2025, to consolidate federal AI oversight.
President Biden signed an executive order on AI in November 2023.
